services.name: Air Conditioning
services.summary: Installation, repair, and tune-up for all AC systems
services.details: Whether your central AC unit has stopped working in a SoCal heat wave or you're building a new home and need a complete system installed, Steve's has the experience to handle it. We service all major brands including Carrier, Lennox, Trane, Rheem, Goodman, Daikin, and more. Our technicians diagnose problems fast and fix them right — without recommending unnecessary repairs. We also offer ductless mini-split installation for garages, additions, and spaces difficult to cool with central systems, plus full equipment retrofit and replacement for aging systems.

services.name: Furnaces
services.summary: Gas, electric, propane, oil, and water furnace installation and repair
services.details: Southern California winters may be mild compared to the rest of the country, but temperatures in the Temecula Valley can drop sharply at night. Steve's installs and services natural gas, electric, propane, oil, and water furnaces for homes of all sizes. If your furnace is short-cycling, producing strange noises, heating unevenly, or driving your gas bill sky-high, call us for a diagnostic. We also handle full equipment retrofit and replacement projects — upgrading older inefficient systems to modern high-efficiency units.

services.name: Heat Pumps
services.details: Heat pumps are one of the most energy-efficient ways to heat and cool your home — ideal for the mild SoCal climate. A single system does the work of both a furnace and an AC unit, moving heat rather than generating it, which means dramatically lower energy bills year-round. We install and service air-source and ground-source heat pumps for residential and light commercial applications.

services.name: Residential Refrigeration
services.details: From custom wine cellars to residential walk-in coolers, Steve's handles the full range of residential refrigeration. Our technicians are certified in refrigerant handling and skilled in both installation and repair of specialty cold storage systems.

services.name: Commercial Refrigeration
services.details: Restaurant walk-ins, commercial freezers, refrigerated display cases — a refrigeration failure means lost product and lost revenue. Steve's provides rapid-response commercial refrigeration repair and full system installation for businesses throughout SW Riverside County. We work around your schedule to minimize downtime.

services.name: HVAC Maintenance
services.summary: Keep it running before it breaks
services.details: The single best way to avoid a mid-summer AC emergency is a proper spring tune-up. Our maintenance service includes a comprehensive system inspection, cleaning of all critical components, refrigerant level check, and a full performance test. We document everything and give you a plain-language report on your system's condition.

services.name: Air Quality Control
services.summary: Healthier indoor air for your home or business
services.details: The air inside your home can be 2-5x more polluted than outdoor air. Steve's installs and services a full range of indoor air quality systems including HRV (Heat Recovery Ventilation), high-efficiency filtration, UV purification, and humidity control. HRV systems are particularly powerful — they bring fresh outdoor air in while capturing heat from the outgoing stale air, dramatically improving air quality without an energy penalty. Better air quality means fewer allergies, better sleep, and protection for vulnerable family members.

services.name: Water Heaters
services.summary: Tank, tankless, and hybrid water heater systems
services.details: Whether you're running out of hot water mid-shower or your old tank is leaking, Steve's installs and services every type of water heater. Traditional tank models (gas, electric, propane), high-efficiency tankless systems for endless hot water on demand, and modern heat-pump hybrid units that can cut your water heating costs in half. Not sure which type is right for your home? We'll walk you through the tradeoffs based on your family size, fuel availability, and budget.

services.name: Energy Audits
services.summary: Comprehensive energy assessments to stop wasted energy and money
services.details: An energy audit is the single most cost-effective service we offer — and one most HVAC contractors don't even provide. Steve's comprehensive audit identifies exactly where your home or business is losing energy: poorly sealed ductwork, insufficient insulation, drafty windows, oversized or undersized HVAC equipment, and thermal weak spots you'd never spot without proper diagnostic equipment. You get a written report with prioritized recommendations and projected savings for each fix. Many customers recover the cost of the audit within 2-3 months of implementing recommendations.

services.name: Ductless Mini-Splits
services.summary: Energy-efficient ductless cooling and heating for additions, garages, and rooms central HVAC can't reach
services.details: Ductless mini-splits are perfect when running new ductwork isn't practical — converted garages, room additions, ADUs, sunrooms, master suites that never cool down, or any space the rest of your system fights to reach. We install Mitsubishi, Daikin, LG, and Fujitsu single-zone and multi-zone systems. Each indoor head has its own thermostat, so you only cool the rooms you're using. They run on standard electric service, qualify for federal tax credits and California rebates, and are dramatically quieter than window units.
features: Garage, addition, ADU, and sunroom installations
Mitsubishi, Daikin, LG, Fujitsu certified installer
Federal tax credits and California rebates available
Heat pump versions for year-round comfort
Repair and refrigerant service on existing systems

services.name: Whole House Fans
services.summary: Pull cool evening air through the house and exhaust hot attic air — slash AC runtime on summer nights
services.details: Inland Empire summers cool off hard at night. A whole-house fan pulls that 65°F evening air through your open windows and pushes the heat out through your attic — usually cooling a whole house in 15–20 minutes for pennies of electricity instead of running the AC. We install QuietCool and AirScape systems sized to your square footage, with proper attic venting calcs so you don't pressurize the attic or back-draft any combustion appliances. Great pairing with solar.
features: Sized to home square footage and attic venting
Repairs and motor replacement on existing fans

services.name: Ductwork & Airflow
services.summary: Duct repair, replacement, sealing, and balancing — fix hot/cold rooms and lower energy bills
services.details: If one room is always hot, your bills jumped, or you can hear the system whistle, the ductwork is usually the culprit. We pressure-test for leaks, repair or replace crushed flex duct, seal connections with mastic (not just tape), and re-balance airflow with dampers. We also size and run new ductwork for additions or full retrofits. Properly sealed ducts can recover 20–30% of the conditioned air your old system was leaking into the attic.
features: New ductwork for additions and ADUs
Sheet metal and flex duct fabrication

services.name: Condenser Relocation
services.summary: Move your outdoor AC unit to free up yard space, reduce noise, or clear room for a remodel or pool build
services.details: Adding a pool, expanding the patio, doing a side-yard remodel, or just tired of the condenser sitting right outside the bedroom window? We relocate outdoor condenser units anywhere on the property — typically up to 50 feet from the original location — including new line set, electrical, pad, and a full vacuum-and-recharge. We coordinate with pool builders and general contractors so the AC isn't down during the remodel.

services.details: We service commercial HVAC across SW Riverside County and the broader Inland Empire — rooftop package units (RTUs), split systems for office suites, makeup air for restaurants, and full equipment changeouts. Service contracts available with priority response and quarterly PMs. We work with property managers, retail tenants, restaurant owners, and small industrial. Crane-set RTU replacements coordinated in-house.
features: Rooftop package unit (RTU) service and replacement
Carrier, Trane, Lennox, York commercial lines
After-hours service for retail and restaurant operations

services.name: Drain Cleaning
services.summary: Condensate drain clearing for AC systems — prevent water damage, ceiling stains, and emergency shutoffs
services.details: AC condensate drains clog with algae and sludge every couple of years, especially here in the Inland Empire. When they back up, the safety switch shuts the AC off mid-summer or — worse — water leaks through the ceiling. We clear the drain line with nitrogen, vacuum, or wet-vac depending on access, treat with algaecide tablets, and verify the safety switch works. Often done as part of a tune-up; available as a standalone service.
features: Available as standalone or with tune-up

services.name: Oven Hood Installation
services.summary: Range hood and oven hood installation, ducting to the exterior, and makeup-air sizing for high-CFM units
services.details: Range hoods don't work without proper exterior venting — recirculating filters just blow the grease and steam back at you. We install range hoods of all sizes, run new duct from the hood to a roof or wall exterior cap, and handle makeup-air calculations for high-CFM commercial-style hoods (anything over 400 CFM in a tight home will starve combustion appliances without it). Works for new construction, remodels, and upgrades from old recirculating units.
features: Range hood and oven hood installation

faqs.q: Do you offer emergency service?
faqs.a: Yes — we offer same-day emergency response for heating and cooling failures. If your AC is out in summer heat or your furnace died on a cold night, call (951) 634-3233 and we'll get someone out to you as fast as possible.

faqs.q: Are you licensed and insured?
faqs.a: Yes. Steve's Air Conditioning & Heating is fully Licensed, Bonded, and Insured. Our technicians are also NATE-certified (North American Technician Excellence) — a nationally recognized HVAC certification. Every job, every tech, fully covered.

faqs.q: What brands do you service?
faqs.a: All major HVAC brands — including Carrier, Lennox, Trane, York, Rheem, Goodman, Daikin, American Standard, Bryant, and Amana. If you have a different brand, call us and ask — we likely service it.

faqs.q: How long have you been in business?
faqs.a: Over 20 years serving the Murrieta-Temecula Valley and Southwest Riverside County.

faqs.q: Do you give free estimates?
faqs.a: Yes — free estimates on installations and replacements. Service-call diagnostic fees may apply for repairs. Call (951) 634-3233 for current rates.

faqs.q: What areas do you cover?
faqs.a: We serve 21 cities across Southwest Riverside County and the broader Inland Empire. Our core service area — same-day to next-day response — is Murrieta, Temecula, Menifee, Wildomar, Lake Elsinore, and Canyon Lake. Nearby cities with 1-3 hour typical response: Sun City, Winchester, French Valley, Perris, Hemet, Romoland, Homeland, Fallbrook, and Rainbow. Extended same-day service to Moreno Valley, Riverside, Corona, San Bernardino, Anza, and Aguanga. If you're outside that list, call and ask — we can often still help.

faqs.q: Can you install a brand I purchase myself?
faqs.a: Call us about that one — equipment-supplied installs are case-by-case. We need to make sure the equipment is right for your home and that any factory warranty isn't voided by the install.

faqs.q: How often should I have my HVAC serviced?
faqs.a: Once a year minimum — ideally a spring AC tune-up and a fall furnace inspection. Annual maintenance catches small problems before they become emergency failures and keeps your system running efficiently.

faqs.q: What's the difference between a heat pump and a regular AC?
faqs.a: A heat pump moves heat in either direction, so it can both cool your home in summer AND heat it in winter — a single system replacing both your AC and furnace. They're very efficient in mild climates like ours, which means lower energy bills year-round. A regular AC only cools.

faqs.q: How long does a new HVAC system last?
faqs.a: With proper maintenance, central AC units typically last 15-20 years, furnaces 15-25 years, and heat pumps 12-15 years. Skipping annual maintenance can cut those numbers dramatically.

faqs.q: Do you do commercial work?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle commercial refrigeration (restaurant walk-ins, freezers, display cases), commercial HVAC, and light commercial heat pump systems. We work around your business schedule to minimize downtime.

faqs.q: Should I repair or replace my old unit?
faqs.a: Call us for an honest assessment. As a rule of thumb: if your system is over 12-15 years old and the repair costs more than half the price of a new unit, replacement usually makes more sense. We'll lay out both options with real numbers — no upsell pressure.

faqs.q: How can I lower my energy bills?
faqs.a: Annual maintenance, a programmable or smart thermostat, sealing duct leaks, replacing filters monthly during heavy-use seasons, and setting your thermostat 2-3° higher in summer / lower in winter. If your system is old and inefficient, a high-SEER replacement can cut cooling costs significantly. We also offer comprehensive energy audits that identify exactly where your home is losing energy — most customers recover the audit cost within 2-3 months of implementing our recommendations.

faqs.q: Do you do energy audits?
faqs.a: Yes. Our comprehensive energy audit identifies exactly where your home or business is losing energy: poorly sealed ductwork, insufficient insulation, drafty windows, oversized or undersized HVAC equipment, and thermal weak spots. You get a written report with prioritized recommendations and projected savings for each fix. Most contractors don't offer this service — we do because it genuinely saves customers money.

faqs.q: Do you install water heaters?
faqs.a: Yes — we install and service every type of water heater: traditional tank models (gas, electric, propane), high-efficiency tankless on-demand systems, and modern heat-pump hybrid units that can cut water heating costs in half. Not sure which is right for your home? Call us and we'll walk you through the tradeoffs based on your family size, fuel availability, and budget.

faqs.q: What's a tankless water heater and is it worth it?
faqs.a: A tankless water heater heats water on demand instead of constantly heating a stored tank. Pros: endless hot water, smaller footprint, longer lifespan (~20 years vs ~10 for tank), and lower energy use. Cons: higher upfront cost, may need gas line / electrical upgrades. Worth it for most homes that use a lot of hot water or want to save space — call (951) 634-3233 and we'll let you know if it's a fit for your situation.

faqs.q: Do you handle indoor air quality issues?
faqs.a: Yes. We install full air quality systems including HRV (Heat Recovery Ventilation), HEPA / MERV-13+ filtration, UV light air purification, whole-home humidifiers/dehumidifiers, and duct cleaning. If you have allergies, asthma, or just notice musty smells or dust buildup, an air quality assessment is a great place to start.

faqs.q: What is HRV (Heat Recovery Ventilation)?
faqs.a: HRV is a system that brings fresh outdoor air into your home while capturing heat (or cool) from the stale air being exhausted out. It dramatically improves indoor air quality without the energy penalty of just opening windows. Especially valuable in modern tightly-sealed homes where natural air exchange is minimal.

faqs.q: Do you do furnace replacements with different fuel types?
faqs.a: Yes — we install and service natural gas, electric, propane, oil, and water furnaces. We also handle full equipment retrofit projects, like converting from oil to gas, or upgrading older inefficient systems to modern high-efficiency units.

faqs.q: Do you install ductless mini-splits?
faqs.a: Yes — single-zone and multi-zone Mitsubishi, Daikin, LG, and Fujitsu systems. Mini-splits are ideal for converted garages, room additions, ADUs, sunrooms, or any room your central system never quite cools. Heat pump versions handle both heating and cooling, qualify for federal tax credits and California rebates, and run dramatically quieter than window units.

faqs.q: What is a whole-house fan and is it worth it in Murrieta?
faqs.a: A whole-house fan pulls cool evening air in through your open windows and exhausts attic heat out through the roof vents. Murrieta and Temecula nights drop into the 60s most of the summer, so a properly-sized fan cools the whole house in 15-20 minutes for pennies of electricity — letting you shut the AC off entirely for most of the night. We install QuietCool and AirScape systems sized to your home and attic venting.

faqs.q: Can you relocate my outdoor AC unit for a pool build or remodel?
faqs.a: Yes — condenser relocations are a regular job for us. Typical relocations are up to 50 feet from the original spot and include new line set, electrical disconnect, pad, vacuum, leak-test, and recharge. We coordinate with pool builders and general contractors so the AC is only down for the day of the move. Call (951) 634-3233 for a site visit and quote.

faqs.q: Do you service commercial HVAC?
faqs.a: Yes — rooftop package units (RTUs), split systems for office suites and retail, restaurant makeup-air, and light industrial. We offer service contracts with priority response and quarterly PMs for property managers and business owners. After-hours service available for retail and restaurant operations.

faqs.q: How fast can you get to me in Corona or Riverside?
faqs.a: Same-day service is typical for our extended-area cities — Moreno Valley, Riverside, Corona, San Bernardino, Anza, and Aguanga. Actual arrival depends on tech availability that day and where they're currently routed. For our core area (Murrieta, Temecula, Menifee, Wildomar, Lake Elsinore, Canyon Lake) we run same-day to next-day on most service calls, with emergency response available.

faqs.q: Can I request a quote online?
faqs.a: Yes — fill out the quote form at /quote/ and we'll get back to you, usually within a few hours during business hours. The form takes about a minute. For emergencies, calling (951) 634-3233 directly is faster.

faqs.q: How do I contact Steve's?
faqs.a: Call (951) 634-3233 for fastest response, email stevesac_6708@yahoo.com, or use the quote form at /quote/. Full contact options are at /contact/. Hours: Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, Sat 8am-3pm, Sunday emergency only.

faqs.q: Where can I see your reviews?
faqs.a: We have over 612 five-star reviews across Google and Yelp. A curated set is at /reviews/, and you can also see real customer stories on the homepage.

tips: Check the thermostat is set to 'cool' and below room temperature
Replace a dirty air filter — this is the #1 cause of weak cooling
Make sure the outside condenser unit isn't blocked by leaves, debris, or overgrown plants
Check the breaker — a tripped breaker is common after power surges
If it's still not cooling, call us — could be low refrigerant or a failing component
Confirm the thermostat is set to 'heat' and the temperature is above the room temperature
Check that the gas valve is open (for gas furnaces)
Replace a dirty air filter
Check for a tripped breaker or blown fuse
Listen for clicking without ignition — could be a bad igniter, common but a tech needs to handle it

troubleshootingTips.issue: AC running but blowing warm air
tips: Check the thermostat fan setting — set to 'auto' not 'on'
Look for ice on the refrigerant lines — if you see it, turn the system off and call us (frozen coil from low refrigerant or airflow problem)
Replace the air filter
Don't keep running it if it's blowing warm — you can damage the compressor
Squealing usually means a belt or motor bearing issue — call us
Banging or clanking can indicate a loose part — turn it off and call
Hissing near the indoor unit can be a refrigerant leak — call us same day
Light clicking at startup is normal; constant clicking is not
Most often a clogged condensate drain line
Turn the AC off to prevent water damage
Don't try to clear it with chemicals — call us, we'll flush it properly

seasonalTips.spring: Schedule your AC tune-up before the first heat wave hits. Replace your air filter. Clear leaves and debris from around the outdoor condenser unit.
seasonalTips.summer: Set your thermostat to 78°F when home, higher when away. Use ceiling fans to feel cooler at higher set points. Close blinds during peak sun hours. Replace filters monthly during heavy use.
seasonalTips.fall: Schedule your furnace inspection before first cold night. Test your heater on a cool day so you find any problems before you actually need it. Replace the filter.
seasonalTips.winter: Set your thermostat to 68°F when home — every degree higher costs about 3% more on heating. Make sure heating vents aren't blocked by furniture. Replace filters every 1-2 months.
